caption: Ownership and attribution in AI work is real and practical. These prompts help you map rights, attribution, and contracts. Save this post and follow @naelbuildingbig for more prompts. What part of AI ownership worries you most? #AIforBusiness #IPRights #AIPolicy #Entrepreneurship

slides.title: 1. Who Owns AI Content?
slides.body: Clarify who owns AI outputs and licenses before use.

slides.title: 1. Quick Rights Check
slides.body: Review AI tool terms for ownership: [role]. Return owner, license scope, and disclosure requirements.

slides.title: 2. Attribution Policy
slides.body: Draft a client-ready attribution rule: [task]. Output a one-paragraph policy and example wording.

slides.title: 3. IP Risk Scan
slides.body: Identify potential IP risks in AI outputs: [idea]. Return a bullet list of claims and mitigations.

slides.title: 4. Client Contract Clause
slides.body: Draft a contract clause covering AI-generated content rights: [draft]. Include scope, attribution, and revocation.

slides.title: 5. Personal Use Policy
slides.body: Create a personal AI use policy for a business: [idea]. Output a one-page policy with do/don'ts and approval workflow.

slides.title: 7. Policy Wins Ownership
slides.body: Formalize ownership with a clear policy to protect value.
